_note: v8 power sheet spec (Phase 7, v8-debug-board). Design intent: hardware/pcb-main-v8/CONTEXT.md 'Power path' (approved by the user 2026-11-03, W2). Same shape as spec.json; Phase 10 generates or modifies the v8 power sheet from it. Refs >= 10/20/30/60 are new in v8 and provisional (Phase 10 annotates). Positions are a coarse grid per block, not a layout. v7_ref marks parts carried over with v7 membership; 'dnp' marks unfitted parts.
